headline: IFFI 2026 to Screen Over 230 Films
summary: The upcoming IFFI 2026 festival in Goa will feature over 230 films from 86 countries, with Spain named as the Country of Honour. The event is scheduled to run from November 20 to 28.

headline: 'Ancessao' to Open Goan Film Section
summary: The Goan Film Section at the upcoming IFFI festival will kick off with the screening of the movie 'Ancessao'. The selection highlights regional cinematic talent at the national event.

summary: Preparations are underway for IFFI 2026 in Goa, which will screen more than 230 films from across 86 countries. The festival takes place from November 20-28.

headline: Six Escape Unhurt as Bus Veers Off Road
summary: Six passengers had a lucky escape when a KRSTC bus veered off the road in Canacona. No major injuries were reported from the incident.

headline: Conditional Bail Granted in Assault Case
summary: A North Goa court has granted conditional bail to a man who was earlier arrested in connection with a minor girl assault case. The accused must comply with specific court stipulations.

headline: Three Arrested for Attempted Murder in Colva
summary: Local police have taken three individuals into custody following an attempted murder incident in Colva. Authorities are continuing their investigation into the motive behind the attack.

summary: The GFDC Grassroots Inter-Centre football tournament has officially kicked off with matches taking place across various centers in Goa. The event aims to nurture young sporting talent.

summary: The Goa government has announced its full support for the upcoming fourth season of the Indian Street Premier League (ISPL). Officials believe the partnership will boost local sports engagement.

summary: Goa kicked off the All India Civil Services Football Tournament in dominant fashion with a 6-2 victory over Maharashtra. The impressive win sets a strong tone for their campaign.

summary: The Goa government has launched the 'Mhajo Flat' scheme aimed at regularizing unregistered flats across the state. The initiative provides property owners a formal pathway for compliance.

summary: Goa Forward Party leader Vijai Sardesai has slammed the state government for severe traffic mismanagement. He also questioned the utility and spending of ₹15 crore on the 'Sarkar Tumchya Dari' initiative.

headline: Satirical Take on Everyday Goan Life
summary: A recent commentary piece explores everyday humorous and quirky situations in Goa. It reflects on local interactions and societal observations.

summary: Farmers in Bicholim have stepped up demands for financial relief and intervention to address agricultural damage caused by mining activities. They are calling on authorities to assess their losses.

summary: Vasco's prominent Swatantra Path is scheduled to undergo a major facelift with completion targeted by the end of December. The project aims to improve urban aesthetics and pedestrian flow.

summary: The latest Special Summary Revision (SSR) draft rolls indicate an increase in the total voter count in Goa, alongside states like Uttarakhand and Manipur. The update reflects shifting demographic numbers.

summary: National Highway 66 continues to enhance travel along Goa's coastline by improving regional connectivity while showcasing natural scenery. The highway is a key artery for regional development.
